yucatan.title: Hopelchén, Campeche (Yucatán Peninsula)
yucatan.summary: Los Chenes, in the Yucatán Peninsula: tropical dry forest being cleared for mechanized farmland. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

villahermosa.title: Villahermosa, Tabasco
villahermosa.summary: Villahermosa sits where the Grijalva and Carrizal rivers meet in Mexico's wettest lowlands, and floods often in the rainy season. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

chapala.title: Lake Chapala, Jalisco
chapala.summary: The hills around Lake Chapala, Mexico's largest lake, burn often in the dry season (March to May). Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

guadalajara.title: Guadalajara, Jalisco
guadalajara.summary: Mexico's second-largest metropolitan area, growing into the farmland and forest around it. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

monterrey.title: Monterrey, Nuevo León
monterrey.summary: Industrial city at the foot of the Sierra Madre Oriental, in a dry region that depends on a few reservoirs. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

vallarta.title: Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco
vallarta.summary: Resort city on Banderas Bay, between the Ameca river valley and forested mountains. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

elpaso.title: El Paso and Ciudad Juárez
elpaso.summary: Two cities and one desert valley split by the Rio Grande, on the border between the United States and Mexico. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

tijuana.title: Tijuana and San Diego (south)
tijuana.summary: Fast-growing border city on steep hills where slopes often fail after rain. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.

cdmx.title: Mexico City
cdmx.summary: Mexico City: dense city on an old lakebed that is sinking as groundwater is pumped out, with farmland at the edges. Radar backscatter, ground motion, and soil moisture.
cdmx.reference_note: Sierra de las Cruces foothills, west of the lakebed: volcanic rock, assumed stable

mexico.title: Mexico
mexico.summary: The whole country at about 2 km, clipped to the border: soil moisture from every NISAR pass in the two latest 12-day cycles, how it changed between them, and recent fire detections. Look up any place for full-detail radar.
